Shallow vs deep copy

A shallow copy creates a new outer object but shares nested references. A deep copy
duplicates supported nested data.

Interview question: Why can spread cause unexpected state mutation?

Answer: Nested object references are shared. Copy each changed level or use a suitable
deep-copy approach.
Remember: Outer copy is not nested copy.
